verdict.rationale: Rootly has its own AI agents (Rootly AI SRE, Rootly AI in Slack and web), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows Rootly running as an MCP server that exposes its own tools to clients like Cursor and Claude Code, which is the opposite role. It also shows first-party AI connectors for Atlassian and AWS, but these are an adjacent feature and are not documented as user-attachable MCP servers. No evidence shows Rootly's AI can consume tools from external MCP servers.
